name: Hakudaku Cafe
source:
"There's not way... I would... feel pleasure from something... something like this...!!" On the way back from delivering some coffee, the cafe's waitress is dragged into an alleyway by some men and endlessly r*ped...

After which, they even make their way to the cafe where she works and fuck her in the toilet...
dragging her friends into the harrowing gangrape-a-thon too. Their violation knows no limits.

What fate awaits these pitiful girls...?

[From DLsite English]
translation:
“怎么可能……我怎么可能会……因为这种……这种事感到舒服啊……！！”咖啡店的女服务员在送完咖啡返回的途中，被几名男子强行拖进小巷，遭到了无休止的凌辱……

事后，这群男人甚至闯入她工作的咖啡店，在厕所里肆意侵犯她……还将她的朋友们一并拖入这场令人绝望的轮奸地狱。他们的暴行毫无底线。

等待这些可怜少女的，将会是怎样的命运……？
